owners.lifetime: authored once; evaluated per frame via AnimationProgram
compile once → per-frame evaluate/raster → sink publish
spawn → wait4 → report; stop token + SIGTERM→SIGKILL

concurrency: Sequential frame loop in export child.
Warm trials use a fresh measured process after an uncounted warmup process.
cancel_rules: stop_requested aborts before the next frame acquire; unpublished outputs stay off the final path.
profiling: Critical path is CPU Scene IR → preview proxy raster → Apple VideoSink.
Metal shadow passes and skinned-mesh GPU work are outside this export path.
Overdraw mitigated by shot-local fade-out + transparent-skip; stage/background layers remain intentional.
